name: NGC 2249 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2249, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2249-hubble
story: A compact gathering of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, NGC 2249 holds a quiet puzzle: its stars leave the main sequence over a wider band than a single generation should. Hubble looked closely to learn why.

claims.text: NGC 2249 is an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud
Its main-sequence turnoff is wider than a single stellar population predicts
Hubble program 12908 targeted NGC 2249 to study extended main-sequence turnoffs
